reason: Free listing I'd let you do if you really load the flyers yourselves, but I'm not paying a monthly fee for an app with 500 people on a waitlist. My margins are thin and any new fee gets cut unless it clearly pays for itself.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform, and I can't see how 39 euro a month fills my bar on a Tuesday when my busy nights, Friday and Saturday, are full anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app really past 2,000 active users in my city and a few bars I know showing me extra people through the door because of it, with the first months free.
